title: 5 open() calls without explicit encoding at lines 123, 139, 183, 233, 259
detail: Five file-open calls rely on the platform default encoding. On systems where the default is not UTF-8, reading sysfs or procfs paths may produce garbled output or decode errors. Add `encoding='utf-8'` (or the appropriate encoding) to each open() call.

title: raise-missing-from: exception chain lost when raising PciDeviceNotFoundById
detail: At line 170, an `except Exception` block raises `PciDeviceNotFoundById` without `from exc`, discarding the original OS error (ENOENT, EACCES, etc.). Adding `from exc` would preserve the root cause in tracebacks.
